name: Kosaka Shiki
source:
"Aah, She got away. It was even the perfect chance for kiss."

2nd year high school student.
Star Sign: Aries
The most popular student on campus.

A classmate of Lapis and Mitsuki, the son of a rich family.
An amateur model who is slightly famous around town.
He's a little smug, but because he's friendly and bright he's popular with both men and women.
He's Mitsuki's only friend.
